  path={"/teams/accounts/{accountId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindByAccount handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve team records associated with a specific account.
It expects the account ID as a URL parameter, validates it, and returns a paginated list of teams
belonging to that account. Returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages for invalid
account IDs or if no teams are found.
